svg.title: Knurl keeps you company while a report builds
svg.desc: An animated demo of a small Shiny reporting app. Knurl, an experimental mascot character, waits with the status “Ready when you are”. When the Run report button is pressed, a short wiggle and Knurl’s mood changes to thinking. The status text follows each step of the job: Reading the data, Fitting the model, Writing the report, while the progress bar fills. When the report is ready Knurl wiggles again, celebrates with a small burst, and then goes back to idle. A code line under the app shows the matching mascot() and update_mascot() calls.

g.text: mascot("helper", mood = "idle", status = "Ready when you are")
update_mascot("helper", mood = "idle", status = "Ready when you are")
